title: Bilingual literal-copy card
summary: An original exact-text fixture that binds three NFC strings to declared SVG text blocks and distinguishes codepoint verification from cross-platform font pixel rendering.

record.title: Bilingual literal-copy card prompt
record.purpose: Provide a bounded exact-text worked example that verifies literal UTF-8/NFC copy without claiming pixel-identical system-font rendering.
record.sourceText: Render three exact strings: 版本 1.0 / EXACT; Keep A/B · 2026; Line 01 — 字符逐字核对.

prompt.positive: A centered information card with three exact text lines: “版本 1.0 / EXACT”, “Keep A/B · 2026”, and “Line 01 — 字符逐字核对”; preserve UTF-8 NFC codepoints, punctuation, case and line order exactly.
prompt.negative: No paraphrase, no translation, no omitted punctuation, no extra text, no logo, no watermark, no external typeface.

subject: one bilingual literal-copy information card
composition: three centered text blocks inside one rounded safe area
constraints: do not alter any declared codepoint
do not claim cross-platform pixel identity

variants.label: Baseline literal copy
variants.change: No variation; retain all checked codepoints and line order.
variants.positive: Retain the three exact strings without translation or punctuation changes.

criteria.check: All three strings preserve NFC codepoints, punctuation, case and order.
criteria.evidence: The deterministic SVG generator escapes and emits the exact visualSpec strings.

knownRisks: System-font glyph metrics may vary by platform even when codepoints are identical.
evaluation.nextExperiment: A future pixel-pinned case would require a redistributable embedded font with separately verified rights.

changeLog: v1: create an original deterministic exact-text prompt fixture.

visualSpec.composition: Three exact NFC strings are centered in separate text blocks within one rounded safe area; punctuation, case and line order are fixed.

criteria.evidence: The local generator must reproduce the committed candidate byte for byte.
The candidate uses static SVG primitives and system-font text only.
The shared creator-owned rights profile is verified and hash-bound.
Every declared exactText string is NFC and occurs exactly once in the rebuilt SVG source.
